critical_code_review_comments: PostTrainingLog.js submits naive local datetime as date_time_start. Ensure backend _local_date_of correctly interprets naive strings vs ISO Z — verified working here but worth a unit test for edge boundaries (23:59 local roll-over).
TheFittest.js DEVICE_TZ falls back to '' on catch — backend _resolve_tz must handle empty string safely (appears to, given the flow succeeded).

rca of the issue: Original bug: Fittest matched today's date using Philadelphia UTC-4 fixed formula on stored UTC timestamps, so 20:00 local (00:00 UTC next day) sessions were classified as 'tomorrow'. Fix (verified working): frontend passes IANA tz via ?tz= (my-trainings-today, eligibility) and body tz (POST posts); backend _local_date_of converts stored timestamps into that tz before extracting date; PostTrainingLog now stores athlete local wall-clock (naive) so date extraction is timezone-consistent.
